source.name: Natural Plan, calendar scheduling
source.format: one JSON object keyed by record id; each record has num_people, num_days, duration, prompt_5shot, prompt_0shot, golden_plan and pred_5shot_pro, all strings

attribution: Natural Plan calendar scheduling records are (c) 2024 DeepMind Technologies Limited, from Zheng et al., "NATURAL PLAN: Benchmarking LLMs on Natural Language Planning" (https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04520), https://github.com/google-deepmind/natural-plan, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: records reduced to the fields num_people, num_days, duration, prompt_0shot and golden_plan.
realism: Natural Plan is generated from fixed natural-language templates, not collected from real scheduling requests: single meetings, one shared time zone and 30-minute increments. It supplies realistic phrasing and verified answers, but not mixed time zones, rooms, buffers or optional attendees.
